name: RapidTriage core forensics #51-#60 internal fixture validation

datasets.name: #51 reviewer workflow fixture assertions

required_assertions: Review marks preserve status, verification, assignment, priority, report inclusion, history/audit warnings, source-viewer locators, queue row hashes, assignment manifest hashes, review_workflow_report_grade_validation_plan ready/blocking slots, trusted reviewer workflow audit diff gates, and #51 core_accuracy_gates.
Reviewer workflow reportability decisions block role-based case-management claims until multi-user RBAC, conflict handling, notifications, signed reviewer SOP, and trusted audit diff evidence exists.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; role-based multi-user review remains commercial blocker.

datasets.name: #52 compare fixture assertions

required_assertions: Compare preserves A/B/C baseline review, hashes, bounded text diff, status counts, source-viewer locators, diff locators, comparison entry hashes, citation manifest hashes, compare_report_grade_validation_plan ready/blocking slots, specialized-diff warning, trusted expected-diff gates, and #52 core_accuracy_gates.

Compare reportability decisions block semantic-diff-complete claims until web three-pane review, binary/image/SQLite/mailbox diff viewers, persistent Case DB compare notes, selection rationale, reviewed citations, and trusted expected diff evidence exist.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; web three-pane review plus semantic binary/image/table/mailbox diff viewers remain future work.

datasets.name: #53 hex viewer fixture assertions

required_assertions: Source preview preserves bounded hex rows, byte offsets, preview hash, byte-search citation support, source validation warning, preview source-locator manifest, row hashes, bounded range citation package metadata, range proof manifest, hex_viewer_report_grade_validation_plan ready/blocking slots, trusted offset manifest gates, and #53 core_accuracy_gates.

Hex viewer reportability decisions block full-source byte-citation claims until interactive jump-to-offset, byte selection hashing, source hash display, sector navigation, trusted offset manifest diff, and external citation package validation exists.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; full interactive byte navigation and source-byte citation package remain validation-gated.

datasets.name: #54 SQLite viewer fixture assertions

required_assertions: SQLite preview preserves read-only open, table/schema inventory, column/index metadata, bounded row preview, preview source manifest hashes, API-backed table pagination, table page proof manifest hashes, restricted contains filters, sqlite_viewer_report_grade_validation_plan ready/blocking slots, deleted/WAL warning, trusted query/schema diff gates, and #54 core_accuracy_gates.

SQLite viewer reportability decisions block deleted-row/WAL-complete claims until browser E2E pagination validation, WAL/journal replay, deleted-row validation, trusted sqlite3 query/schema diff, selected-row export workflow, FTS/virtual-table review, and large database corpus evidence exists.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; deleted-row/WAL and large database corpus validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #55 email conversation viewer fixture assertions

required_assertions: Email preview preserves thread grouping, message order, participant/header fields, conversation source manifest hashes, attachment hash inventory, bounded attachment citation packages, attachment proof manifest hashes, email_viewer_report_grade_validation_plan ready/blocking slots, mailbox limitations, trusted thread/export diff gates, and #55 core_accuracy_gates.

Email viewer reportability decisions block native-mailbox-thread-complete claims until PST/OST/MSG decoding, deleted item recovery, native mailbox attachment extraction, Message-ID graph validation, trusted mail client thread export diff, and mailbox corpus validation exists.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; native PST/OST/MSG conversation validation remains required.

datasets.name: #56 image gallery fixture assertions

required_assertions: Image rows/previews preserve metadata, hashes, thumbnail metadata, perceptual similarity bucket, source manifest row hashes, bounded folder gallery pages, page manifest row hashes, bucket filters, tag/report hints, image_gallery_report_grade_validation_plan ready/blocking slots, classifier limitation, trusted image gallery manifest diff gates, and #56 core_accuracy_gates.

Image gallery reportability decisions block ML/sensitive-media-complete claims until virtualized gallery, persistent tags, ML similarity, sensitive/deepfake classifier validation, trusted image manifest evidence, and selected-image report export exist.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; dedicated gallery UI, persistent tags, ML/sensitive classifier validation, trusted gallery diff, and selected export remain blockers.

datasets.name: #57 media transcript fixture assertions

required_assertions: Media preview preserves media metadata, source hashes, transcript sidecars, cue timestamps, media-transcript-source-manifest-v1 sidecar/cue hashes, bounded cue citation packages, media-cue-proof-manifest-v1, media_transcript_report_grade_validation_plan ready/blocking slots, verification warning, trusted transcript cue/alignment diff gates, and #57 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; playback sandbox, ASR/manual alignment, waveform/thumb previews, trusted cue diff, alignment corpus, and selected-cue export remain blockers.
